requirements.title: Enter module results
requirements.statement: A student enters one or more module results, each with a module code, credit value, letter grade and whether it counts toward GPA, adding and removing rows dynamically.

requirements.title: Calculate credit-weighted GPA
requirements.statement: The system calculates the credit-weighted GPA of the entered module results using the accepted grading policy.

requirements.title: Validate module results
requirements.statement: The system rejects module results with a missing module code, a credit value outside 1 to 20, or a grade that is not in the accepted grading policy, and reports field-level errors.

requirements.title: Keep calculation history
requirements.statement: The system stores each successful GPA calculation and lists previous calculations, newest first.

requirements.title: Disclose grading policy
requirements.statement: Every GPA result and the entry screen disclose the grading policy identifier, version and authority status used for the calculation.
